changelog: **The domain-event catalogue and the `DomainEvent` record (#1691):** `src/lib/events/catalog.ts` is now the one versioned vocabulary of everything the product can raise — `name` + `version`, a `subjectType`, a strict zod payload schema, `public`/`internal` visibility and a description. Its public entries ARE `WEBHOOK_EVENTS` (re-exported unchanged, same fifteen names in the same order, so the admin form and the published `x-webhooks` block do not move), and their version-1 schemas are exactly what the ten producer call sites dispatch today, `meeting.scheduled`'s three shapes and `interaction.logged`'s two included. Nine internal events the spine and the outbox need are declared, ids only. New append-only `DomainEvent` table (purely additive; registered in `TENANT_MODELS`) — the one event table the outbox (#1680) will extend — pruned by a `domainEvent` entry in the one retention registry under the new global `domainEventRetentionDays` setting (90 days). Separate on purpose from the notification catalogue; see `docs/domain-events.md`.
